name: Return to Bellowfiz

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know stout Evershine is in high demand across Dun Morogh. Bringing it safely to thirsty comrades comes naturally.
Pilot Bellowfiz is a dwarven siege-engine driver at Steelgrill's Depot. Keeping hardworking engineers refreshed helps the machines run smoothly.
As an Alliance member, you help morale and camaraderie among forces in Dun Morogh by carrying favors between dwarven hunters and pilots.

faq.answer: You carry a fresh cask of Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: What is the quest Return to Bellowfiz?

faq.answer: Pilot Bellowfiz is a dwarven siege-engine driver stationed at Steelgrill's Depot, just outside Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He is eager to try a fresh delivery of Evershine.
Evershine is a potent local brew made in Dun Morogh and kept in a sturdy cask. Thirsty pilots and locals prize it.
faq.q: What is the cask of Evershine?

faq.answer: Take the cask to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot, an engineering hub and workshop just east of Kharanos in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: Where do you deliver the cask?

faq.answer: After you help with hunting in the region, you receive a cask of Evershine for Pilot Bellowfiz. He eagerly awaits a taste.
faq.q: Why was the Evershine sent to Bellowfiz?

aliases: what does bellowfiz do with brew
faq.answer: When Pilot Bellowfiz receives the cask, he says it will do just fine and moves at once to open a bottle for a taste.
faq.q: What happens when Bellowfiz receives the Evershine?

sections.body: After helping with local hunting, you receive a fresh cask of Evershine for Pilot Bellowfiz. Carry it through snowy Dun Morogh to Steelgrill's Depot. Such favors help people on the cold frontier look after one another.
sections.title: A Cask for the Depot

sections.body: Steelgrill's Depot lies just outside Kharanos. Gnomes test machinery, tend vehicles, and practice their craft there. The pilots face freezing winds and welcome a strong local drink. When you arrive with the cask, Pilot Bellowfiz is eager to uncork a bottle and taste the brew made by locals.
sections.title: Thirsty Aviators

summary: You bring Evershine to Pilot Bellowfiz at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh. After the local hunting, the thirsty driver awaits a fresh drink.
attribution: In-game quest text: Return to Bellowfiz
